name: rustle
description: The viewer's rustle, as on the blog: the color wave's interference field, measured from the viewer's origin (the start view), nudges each splat by 0.02 of its wave color, so the scene shivers like leaves.

source.name: World Labs threeviewer effects (newEffects.glsl colorWave, vertexWorld rustle), blog demo parameters
